head.title: Listing moderation
head.description: Review the listing, then approve it, reject it for changes or block it.

pending.title: No listings left to review
pending.description: New listings appear here as soon as they are submitted.

decided.title: No listings here
decided.description: Listings appear here after you make a decision.

photos.label: The photos are clear and show the home

personalData.label: No people, documents or personal data in the photos

price.label: The price and area are plausible

description.label: The description is accurate, with no contact details

rejected.hint: The owner gets the reason and can edit and resubmit the listing.

blocked.hint: The listing will not be published and can no longer be edited or resubmitted. The owner sees the reason in their account.

confirmBlock.title: Block this listing?
confirmBlock.description: “{{title}}” can no longer be edited or resubmitted. This decision is final.

photos.label: Too few or unclear photos
photos.message: Add more clear photos, one for each room.

personal_data.label: Personal data in the photos
personal_data.message: Some photos show documents or personal data. Remove them.

price_area.label: Wrong price or area
price_area.message: Check the price and area; they do not match the area's figures.

description.label: Incomplete description
description.message: Complete the description with the condition of the home and its amenities.

contact_details.label: Contact details in the text
contact_details.message: Remove the phone number from the description; buyers contact you through the portal.

duplicate.label: Duplicate listing
duplicate.message: This home is already published in another listing.

unavailable.label: The home does not exist or is sold
unavailable.message: We could not confirm that the home is available.

rules.label: Breaks the portal rules
rules.message: The listing breaks the portal's publishing rules.

toast.rejected: {{title}} was rejected. The owner can edit and resubmit the listing.
toast.blocked: {{title}} was blocked. The owner sees the reason in their account.

previewDialog.title: Public preview
previewDialog.description: This is how the listing appears on the site once approved.
